base_rule: Third or later documented reverse split AND saved S7 rally veto; missing history excluded.
threshold_policy: Fixed thresholds inherited from the framework or prior study. No threshold grid. All 19 current incremental claims receive Holm correction; prior historical exploration remains disclosed.

feature_rules.reported_runway: Reported cash / negative TTM CFO <0.5 years; not financing-adjusted
feature_rules.dilution: Split-adjusted common-share growth >=25% over 150–240 days; proven bounds retained as bounds
feature_rules.margin8: TTM operating-margin YoY change <=-8 percentage points
feature_rules.accrual10: (TTM NI - TTM CFO) / average exact current and year-ago assets >=10%; no last-asset fallback
feature_rules.profit_no_cash: TTM NI>0 and TTM total CFO<0
feature_rules.debt_distress: Dated operating profile, negative total CFO, TTM and reconstructed-quarter reported runways <=1 year, operating loss, explicit next-12-month debt maturity>cash
feature_rules.legacy_score60: Unmodified prior source-bound score>=60; diagnostic comparator, not a rebuilt score

source_policy: Original as-of filings and companyfacts; same currency; no future-public data, current SIC backfill, inferred zero debt, weighted EPS share substitutions or invented financing reviews. Banks/lenders/funds with dated profiles disable inappropriate cash/accrual lenses; unknown applicability remains explicit research limitation.

sensitivities.full_target: $25k without account/volume cap, strict SSR; hypothetical fills, not capacity proof
sensitivities.passive_SSR_proxy: Separate sensitivity with unverified capture; never verified execution
sensitivities.maturity: Common 20-session maturity exclusion for both horizons

validation: Reproduce frozen legacy h10 and h20 full-size baselines and frozen strict S7 result.
Compare each addition with saved S7 baseline and same-feature-covered S7 control.
Issuer-cluster and six-month calendar-block uncertainty; 4,000 draws and Holm over 19 claims.
All entry-year cohorts; issuer concentration, leave-best-one/five subtraction, and removal replays for declared focus arms.
Quarterly walk-forward selection using only fully closed, returned-loan training labels and a 20-session embargo; minimum 30 issuers, otherwise saved screen.
10-session replication, 0.1%/1%/5% participation, 20%/50%/150% APR cost cases, full-target and SSR sensitivities.

At least 30 selected issuers, positive matched increments with corrected evidence, no worse drawdown, positive concentration sensitivities, no unresolved position/loan, no risk-breach sessions, and positive stress results for research candidacy.
All history is already explored development data. No untouched historical holdout or live profitability claim.
unavailable_live_gates: Independently verified completed issuance and saleable common float
Timestamped borrow quantity/APR and actual fills
Valuation, catalyst, contrary evidence and falsifiers from six-lens underwriting
